stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $635 Million as BTC Tests Holders' Cost Basis
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETFs recorded $635 million in net outflows, CryptoSlate reports. The outflows came as BTC's price neared the estimated $81,500 average cost basis of ETF holdings. A drop below that level could push many ETF holders into unrealized losses.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows now move Bitcoin's price directly, and a break below the average cost basis could trigger further selling.
whatToWatch: Whether BTC holds above or falls below the $81,500 level
Daily ETF flow data in coming sessions
questions: Will outflows accelerate if BTC breaks below $81,500?
How concentrated is the cost basis across individual ETF issuers?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $635 million as BTC tests their holdings’ estimated $81,500 cost basis

stories.title: Bitcoin's Bounce to $80,000 Raises Questions About Exchange Liquidity
stories.summary: Bitcoin recovered toward $80,000, but CryptoSlate reports the move came alongside a $14 billion swing in Tether flows on Binance. The scale of that stablecoin movement raises questions about how much of the recovery reflects real demand versus liquidity shifts on a single exchange.
stories.whyItMatters: Large, concentrated stablecoin flows on one exchange can distort price signals that traders read as organic demand.
whatToWatch: Whether Tether flows on Binance stabilize or keep swinging
If the $80,000 level holds without further large flow swings
questions: What drove the $14 billion swing in Tether flows?
Is the price recovery sustainable without it?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s $80,000 recovery faces liquidity questions as Binance’s Tether flows swing $14 billion

stories.title: Tether Study Finds Cloud AI Tokens Can Cost More Than Buying Hardware
stories.summary: Tether published its own study comparing the cost of running AI workloads on cloud token pricing versus buying hardware outright, per CryptoSlate. The study reportedly found that beyond certain usage levels, buying a laptop or similar hardware can be cheaper than paying for cloud AI tokens.
stories.whyItMatters: Tether's move into AI and compute economics shows how major stablecoin issuers are diversifying, which matters for a reader tracking the companies behind key stablecoins.
whatToWatch: Whether Tether follows up with hardware or compute investments
questions: What assumptions and workloads did the study use?
Is the study self-interested given Tether's other business lines?

sources.title: Tether’s own AI study shows when buying a laptop costs more than cloud tokens

stories.title: Uniswap Adds Seven Liquidity Sources as 0x Disputes Hook Protection Claims
stories.summary: Uniswap added seven new trading sources to its aggregation, CryptoSlate reports. Separately, rival protocol 0x is disputing Uniswap's claims about its protection against malicious hooks, custom code that can run extra logic on trades.
stories.whyItMatters: Hooks are a newer, still-maturing part of Uniswap's design, so disputes over their safety matter to anyone routing trades through the protocol.
whatToWatch: Any further detail on the specific hook risks at issue
questions: What exactly does 0x claim Uniswap's protection fails to cover?

sources.title: Uniswap adds seven trading sources as 0x disputes its protection from malicious hooks

stories.title: Coinbase to Delist Japanese Yen Stablecoin Years After Crash and Lawsuits
stories.summary: Coinbase plans to drop a Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin from its platform, CryptoSlate reports. The token had crashed in price years earlier, an event that led to investor lawsuits.
stories.whyItMatters: Stablecoin delistings by major exchanges signal which tokens have lost institutional confidence, relevant to anyone holding or trading yen-pegged assets.
whatToWatch: The timeline Coinbase sets for the delisting
Any update on the status of the related lawsuits
questions: Why is Coinbase acting now rather than earlier?
What happens to holders' remaining balances?

sources.title: Coinbase to drop this Japanese yen stablecoin years after its price crash sparked investor lawsuits

stories.title: UK Regulator Says Algorithmic Trade Routing in Crypto Apps May Require a License
stories.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority said crypto apps that use algorithms to choose trade routes may need to hold a license, CryptoSlate reports. The statement signals the FCA's view that automated order routing can fall under existing regulated activities.
stories.whyItMatters: This could force crypto trading apps operating in the UK to register or change how they route orders, affecting access for UK users.
whatToWatch: Formal guidance or enforcement action from the FCA
Whether affected apps apply for licenses or restrict UK access
questions: Which specific apps or routing practices does the FCA have in mind?

sources.title: UK’s FCA says crypto apps may need licenses when algorithms choose trade routes

stories.title: AX1 Console 2.0 Pitches Itself as an 'Agentic Activities Launchpad'
stories.summary: CryptoSlate published an explainer on AX1 Console 2.0, describing it as an 'agentic activities launchpad.' Details beyond the concept description are limited in the available reporting.
stories.whyItMatters: Agentic AI tools tied to crypto launchpads are a growing trend, though the practical use case here is not yet well established.
whatToWatch: Further detail on what AX1 Console 2.0 actually enables for users
questions: What distinguishes this from other crypto launchpads?
Who is behind the project and what traction does it have?

sources.title: What Is an Agentic Activities Launchpad? Inside AX1 Console 2.0

stories.title: SpaceX Perpetual Futures See About $6 Billion in Trading After Earnings
stories.summary: Perpetual futures contracts tied to SpaceX traded roughly $6 billion in volume following the company's earnings, CryptoSlate reports. These derivative products let traders speculate on private company valuations without holding actual equity.
stories.whyItMatters: Perpetual futures on private companies like SpaceX extend crypto-style derivatives trading into assets that are normally illiquid and closed to retail investors.
whatToWatch: Whether volume on SpaceX perps holds up after the earnings-driven spike
Any regulatory response to private-company perpetual futures
questions: Which platform lists these contracts, and how is the reference price set?
What oversight, if any, applies to this market?

sources.title: SpaceX perpetual futures traded about $6 billion after earnings

stories.title: Evernorth's $132 Million Funding Option Could Add XRP, but Dilute Per-Share Holdings
stories.summary: Evernorth has a funding option worth $132 million that could let it buy more XRP, CryptoSlate reports. The structure could also reduce the amount of XRP backing each share, a dilution trade-off for existing shareholders.
stories.whyItMatters: This is a relevant case study in how XRP-linked investment vehicles balance growing their holdings against diluting existing investors.
whatToWatch: Whether Evernorth exercises the funding option
Updates on XRP-per-share metrics if it does
questions: How much dilution would shareholders actually see?
What is driving the decision timeline?

sources.title: Evernorth’s $132 million funding option could buy more XRP while reducing XRP per share

stories.title: Coinbase Ireland's Client Cash Safeguards Fell €5 Million Short Before 2024 Fix
stories.summary: Coinbase's Irish entity had a €5 million shortfall in its client cash safeguarding before correcting the issue in 2024, CryptoSlate reports. Safeguarding rules are meant to keep customer funds held by regulated firms protected and separate from company funds.
stories.whyItMatters: Shortfalls in client money protection at a major exchange's EU entity raise questions about internal controls, even after a fix.
whatToWatch: Whether Irish or EU regulators take further action
Any disclosure of how the shortfall occurred
questions: How long did the shortfall exist before detection?
Were any customers affected before the 2024 fix?

sources.title: Coinbase Ireland’s cash safeguards fell €5 million short before 2024 fix
